scope: All tree occurrences of remove_files/removal_order/REMOVAL_ORDER/verify_union, plus Removals, removal reports and target-filter settings consumers.
streams: One cfg.remove_files list shared across streams; keys, not stream labels, determine matches. Synthetic pointing keys remove no VQA/pose fixture rows. There is no implicit stream exemption if an identical key is reused.
union: The added pointing list is not a replacement for v7_k1_union or its extra list; their schema and relative-order checks stay intact.
fixture_limits: Naming authentication calls are mocked only for fixed production-hash order tests; wrong naming bytes refuse natively. Removals/union tests use real SHA256 pins over retained synthetic bytes, not the unavailable production list payload.
instruction_scope: Internal requested build identifiers and baseline comparisons are retained to identify deliverables and verify the explicitly required delta; no process-history prose.
